features.title: Sworn protector
features.text: Champions pair strong armor with a cause and divine powers. Staying close enough to intervene can matter more than chasing an extra attack.

features.title: Reactions and devotion
features.text: Your cause determines your reaction and priorities. Devotion spells can heal or harm; protection, punishment and support vary with your choices.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3 → 3. Reliable martial attacks lack the damage or accuracy engines of dedicated strikers.
ratings.defense: 5 → 5. Armor progression, shields and defensive abilities make durability a defining strength.
ratings.support: 3 → 4–5. Protection reactions and devotion spells directly prevent harm or restore allies; cause and feats alter emphasis.
ratings.utility: 1.5 → 1.5–2.5. Religion and chosen skills offer some tools; devotion choices can add utility.
ratings.difficulty: 2 → 2.5. Positioning and reaction timing matter even with a fairly direct turn structure.
